rationale: Native baseline opens involve both Q4 drain nets and CH3_SBU1_RELAY. Q4 sits 25 mm above its resistor field. Move Q4 into that field at R92's location; move R92 next to its actual transistor Q3. This shortens several broken net spans without moving a port, changing a net, adding copper or altering rules. Native preflight must verify unlike package sizes fit both existing clearances.
